51289636.protein: High affinity nerve growth factor receptor
51289636.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant human biotinylated and N- terminal DYKDDDDK-tagged TrkA kinase domain (436-790 residues) expressed in Sf21 cells assessed as equilibrium constant by SPR based single cycle kinetics analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: To further ascertain the lead to be true hTrkA inhibitors, biophysical characterization was performed using the surface plasmon resonance technique and the single cycle kinetic protocols (supplementary information Exp. 1S). The outcome clearly revealed 1a to be very active against the kinase domain of hTrkA and hTrkB with fast association and slow dissociation kinetics along with nanomolar affinity (Table 2) and an ~4-fold selectivity over the closest hTrkB isoform in this assay format.
